description: Issues the token the iPhone share extension saves posts with: it can call post_save in this workspace and nothing else (the scope study:add). One per workspace: asking again replaces the old token. It is shown once. Revoke it under Agents and keys with api_key_revoke. Only a signed-in person can ask.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: share_token_issue
title: Make the share extension's token
